name: Layered Parallax Reveal
description: Full-screen hero of stacked photo layers with a large title between them. On scroll each layer moves at its own speed to create depth, fading into a dark section below.
contents: Background photo layer, mountain layer, large title layer and foreground person layer
Bottom fade gradient and a following empty scroll section
behavior: Four layers shift vertically at different percentages while scrolling through the hero
Optional smooth scrolling through Lenis synced to the GSAP ticker
Animation is tied to ScrollTrigger with configurable start, end and scrub
editableByProps: Title text and size, all three images
Background, text, line, fade and spacer colors
Movement distance of each layer, scrub and trigger range
Turn smooth scrolling on or off

needsCodeEdit.where: linear-gradient background in the bottom fade div

needsCodeEdit.change: Put content in the section after the hero

fixed: Takes over page scrolling with Lenis when enableLenis is true, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Includes a 100svh empty section below the hero that gives the parallax its scroll range
Hero fades into the next section with a bottom gradient
